# usage named

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageNamed`](gmeow-usageNamed.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageNamed>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity that is called by the appellation in a name-usage.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usageNamed`](gmeow-usageNamed.md) from [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind the named-entity player of a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) — the entity that is called by the appellation in this use (its [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator) who-is-named role).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as a generic bearing property (that is [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md) / [`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md)) and avoid attaching it to anything but a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md); it names a relator player, not a direct fact.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:usageNamed`](gmeow-usageNamed.md) to the entity once per [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) (functional), pairing it with [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](gmeow-usageAppellation.md); when the named entity is a [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) the usage is inferred to be a [`gmeow:PlaceNaming`](../classes/gmeow-PlaceNaming.md).

### Examples

- ex:usageFamily [`gmeow:usageNamed`](gmeow-usageNamed.md) ex:genny.
